name: LangSwitcher
author: Stealth
description: Fix text typed in the wrong keyboard layout (EN/UK/PL) with a hotkey.

barWidget.description: Convert text typed in the wrong layout (EN/UK/PL)

schema.label: Left click
schema.description: Convert the selected text, the line left of the cursor, the last word, or open the panel.

schema.label: Middle click
schema.description: Same actions as the left click.

schema.label: Right click
schema.description: Default opens the panel with all three actions and the dependency status.
